title: SB 2293 (2022 Regular Session): Mississippi Voter Identification Cards; delete references to constitutional amendment.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-7(1))
(quote) The card shall be valid for the purpose of voter identification purposes under Section 23-15-563 and available only to registered voters of this state.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-7(1))
(quote) No fee shall be charged or collected for the application for or issuance of a Mississippi Voter Identification Card.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-7(6))
(quote) The registrar shall require presentation and verification of any of the following information during the application process before issuance of a Mississippi Voter Identification Card: (a) A photo identity document; or (b) Documentation showing the person's date and place of birth; or (c) A social security card; or (d) A Medicare card; or (e) A Medicaid card;
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-7(2))
(quote) The registrar of each county shall provide a location in the registrar's office at which he or she shall accept applications for Mississippi Voter Identification Cards * * *;
(other) Sec. 1 (23-15-7): voter ID card statute reprinted; deleted words are references to the Mississippi Constitution (shown as "* * *")
(other) Sec. 2 (23-15-135): same deletion of the constitutional reference in the registrar duty to take voter ID card applications
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
